primitives.name: Source Snapshot Hash Integrity
primitives.verbatim_quote: | | Snapshot hash-only | Production source snapshots keep SHA-256 hash, byte count, and metadata while omitting raw payload JSON by default.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'s': 'source object, dimensionless', 'H(s)': 'hash value, SHA-256 digest (bytes)', 's_meta': 'metadata subset of s, dimensionless'}
primitives.assumptions: Payload data is excluded from integrity checks to reduce cost.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When payload inclusion is required, hash integrity fails.

layer2.mapping: Hash-only snapshots form a derived kernel in GSI's probabilistic source tracking, enabling fast verification without full payload access.
layer2.telemetry: Hash mismatch rate and metadata completeness.

primitives.name: CDN Cache Control Policy
primitives.verbatim_quote: | | CDN/cache policy | Admin and monitoring endpoints use `Cache-Control: no-store`; the public promotions route has a short public cache only after compliance filtering.
primitives.assumptions: Cache directives are enforced per route and user context.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Cross-user cache leakage occurs when TTL is extended beyond compliance.

layer2.mapping: Cache policy mirrors GSE’s edge routing logic, where route-specific caching rules determine telemetry exposure and state consistency.
layer2.telemetry: Cache hit ratio and compliance filter bypasses.
